title: New Customer shows both tier fields on Default
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin whose role has 'Settings — Parts', 'See Financial Data', 'Customers — View', 'Customers — Create & Edit' and 'View and Manage AP/AR Data'.
  • Have a new tier for this test, tier A, with a name no other tier uses, so the client has more than one active tier.
  • Use a desktop browser window at least 1440 pixels wide, at 100% zoom, so every column of the page shows.
custom_steps:
1. Open Customers.
  2. Click New Customer.
  3. Type a name no other customer uses in Name.
  4. Click Save.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • The Customers list shows.

Step 2:

  • New Customer shows Work Order Tier and Part Sales Tier, both on Default.
  • They are the first pricing fields on the form.

Step 3:

  • The name shows in Name.

Step 4:

  • The new customer's card shows Work Order Tier 1 · Default and Part Sales Tier 1 · Default.
